meta.title: SaaS Template
meta.description: A modern SaaS template built with Next.js 15 and Cloudflare Workers, designed for scalability and performance.

Hero.description: A complete, production-ready starter for building SaaS apps on Cloudflare Workers. Auth, database, billing, email, and admin tooling are already wired up — clone it and deploy globally in minutes.

Features.heading: Skip the boilerplate. Build the product.
Features.description: Every undifferentiated part of a SaaS is already here and tested. Open the repo and start writing the code that only your product needs.

auth.name: Authentication, solved
auth.description: Email and password sign-in, sign-up, password reset, and sessions on Lucia Auth — plus passkeys and Google OAuth.

data.name: Database & email
data.description: Drizzle ORM over Cloudflare D1, KV-backed sessions, and transactional email sent straight from the Worker.

edge.name: Deployed to the edge
edge.description: Ship to Cloudflare Workers and serve from 330+ cities with zero cold starts. One command pushes to production.

runtime.name: Modern runtime
runtime.description: Next.js App Router and React Server Components running on Vinext and Vite for an instant dev loop.

billing.name: Billing built in
billing.description: Per-team Stripe subscriptions with an embedded Payment Element are wired up, so you can charge customers without starting from scratch.

ui.name: A real design system
ui.description: Tailwind CSS with Shadcn and Base UI components, dark mode, and responsive layouts ready to extend.

teams.name: Teams & admin
teams.description: Multi-tenant teams, role-based access, and an admin panel for managing users and content out of the box.

dx.name: Developer experience
dx.description: TypeScript end to end, Oxlint, a CMS for blog and docs, and GitHub Actions deployment you don't have to write.

Cta.description: Free and open source. No license fees, no attribution required. Fork it, rename it, and make it your own.

Faq.heading: Questions, answered
Faq.description: Still curious? The README covers everything else, and issues are always open.

isFree.question: Is this template really free?
isFree.answer: Yes, this template is completely free and <link>open source</link>! You can use it for both personal and commercial projects without any licensing fees. You can fork, copy, modify, and distribute it as you see fit without any restrictions and attribution.

featuresIncluded.question: What features are included?
featuresIncluded.intro: The template includes a comprehensive set of features:
featuresIncluded.item1: Authentication with email/password and forgot password flow
featuresIncluded.item2: Database integration with Drizzle ORM and Cloudflare D1
featuresIncluded.item3: Email service powered by Cloudflare Email Service
featuresIncluded.item4: Modern UI components from Shadcn UI and Tailwind CSS

techStack.question: What's the tech stack?
techStack.intro: The template uses modern and reliable technologies:
techStack.item1: Next.js App Router with React Server Components through Vinext and Vite
techStack.item3: Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI for styling
techStack.item4: DrizzleORM with Cloudflare D1 for database
techStack.item8: Cloudflare Email Service for transactional email

deploy.question: How do I deploy my application?
deploy.intro: Deployment is automated with GitHub Actions. You'll need to:
deploy.item1: Create Cloudflare D1 and KV namespaces
deploy.item2: Onboard your sending domain in Cloudflare Email Service
deploy.item3: Enable Cloudflare Images for image optimization
deploy.item5: Add your Cloudflare API token to GitHub secrets
deploy.outro: The deployment process is fully documented in the <link>GitHub repository</link>.

gettingStarted.question: What do I need to get started?
gettingStarted.paragraph1: You'll need a Cloudflare account (free tier is fine), Node.js installed locally, and basic knowledge of React and TypeScript. The template includes detailed documentation to guide you through the setup.
gettingStarted.paragraph2: You can also check out the <link>documentation</link> for more information.

roadmap.question: What are the upcoming features?
roadmap.intro: We have an exciting roadmap ahead! Planned features include:

emailTemplates.question: How are email templates handled?
emailTemplates.answer: Transactional email templates are rendered by the app and sent through Cloudflare Email Service from the Worker.

customize.question: How do I customize the template?
customize.intro: Before deploying to production, you should:
customize.item3: Optionally update the color palette in src/app/globals.css

contribute.question: How can I contribute?
contribute.answer: Contributions are welcome! Feel free to open issues, submit pull requests, or help improve the documentation on <link>GitHub</link>. The project follows standard open source contribution guidelines.
